# coordinate matrix frame

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:coordinateMatrixFrame`](gmeow-coordinateMatrixFrame.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/coordinateMatrixFrame>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sensory-environment`](../../slices/sensory-environment.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The reference frame in which this [`CoordinateMatrix`](../classes/gmeow-CoordinateMatrix.md) is expressed. Functional: a matrix is expressed in exactly one frame; frame transformation is a solver concern ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)). Sub-property of [`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md) so the frame-inheritance property chain ([`isResultOf`](gmeow-isResultOf.md) ∘ [`hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md) ⊑ [`hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md)) applies automatically.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:CoordinateMatrix`](../classes/gmeow-CoordinateMatrix.md) -> [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md); functional
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:coordinateMatrixFrame`](gmeow-coordinateMatrixFrame.md) from [`gmeow:CoordinateMatrix`](../classes/gmeow-CoordinateMatrix.md) to [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
